status: All 32 nodes implemented in the opt-in full-crew prototype on 2026-10-15; measured balance and production migration remain pending.

nodes.contract: Arc Tether deals 20% more stability damage. Its HP damage, Shock and cooldown are unchanged.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Grounded Wire

nodes.contract: Cryo Vent base power increases from 55 to 65. It applies Brittle for 2 target turns and does not apply Frozen.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Controlled Vent

nodes.contract: New active: one enemy; physical; base power 100; agility scaling; cooldown 3 personal turns; 50% more stability damage than its normal resolved hit; no status application.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Breaker Bolt

nodes.contract: Nova direct hits deal 15% more HP damage to a target with Weak or Brittle. Having both does not double this bonus; no damage-over-time bonus.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Exposed Seam

nodes.contract: Permanent +1 Speed, added to the base Speed input once. Does not add Agility or a percentage speed multiplier.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Quiet Steps

nodes.contract: New active: all living enemies; physical; base power 60; agility scaling; cooldown 2 personal turns; no status or guard-breaking effect.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Scatter Charge

nodes.contract: Nova direct hits deal 15% more HP damage to a target above 75% HP when that hit is evaluated. No damage-over-time bonus.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Hot Start

nodes.contract: After Nova personally defeats at least one enemy with a damaging action, apply Shield to Nova for 1 personal turn. At most once per action and twice per battle; damage-over-time kills do not trigger it.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Keep Moving

nodes.contract: New active: one living ally, including Zeke; cooldown 3 personal turns; applies Shield for 2 target turns (25% less incoming damage under the reviewed Shield rule); no heal, damage or interception.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Cover

nodes.contract: Permanent +1 Vitality. Derived maximum HP and defense change through their shared formulas; no duplicate flat HP bonus.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Reinforced Harness

nodes.contract: Cover additionally restores 20 stability to its target, capped at that target current maximum. Does not heal HP, remove an existing skip effect or grant a turn.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Steady Cover

nodes.contract: Once per battle, Zeke may cast Cover while it is on cooldown if the selected living ally is below 30% HP at commitment. Spend a normal ATB action, apply ordinary Cover and Steady Cover if learned, and restart Cover's full 3-turn cooldown. Consume the emergency charge only for a valid cast that bypassed an active cooldown. No extra Guard, stronger Shield, heal, free action or stacked Shield copy.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Last Line

nodes.contract: Permanent +1 Strength; derived Attack changes through the shared formula.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Training Session

nodes.contract: Shatter Blow deals 20% more stability damage. Its HP damage, Weak duration and cooldown are unchanged.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Fault Line

nodes.contract: When Shatter Blow successfully applies Weak, also mark that enemy for 2 target turns. The next direct damaging action from another crew member consumes the mark for +10% HP damage against that enemy. One mark per target; reapplication refreshes but does not stack; damage-over-time and Zeke own actions do not consume it.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Opening

nodes.contract: Zeke physical direct hits against an enemy with Weak deal 15% more stability damage. No HP damage bonus, immunity bypass or extra skipped turn.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Controlled Demolition

nodes.contract: Permanent +1 Vitality; maximum HP and defense use the shared formulas.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Field Resilience

nodes.contract: New active: one living ally; cooldown 4 personal turns; restore 20% of target derived maximum HP, rounded down with minimum 1 and capped at missing HP. No Focus multiplier, resurrection or baseline recovery-over-time effect.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Field Treatment

nodes.contract: Field Treatment restores an additional 5% of target maximum HP when the target is below 35% HP before the cast, for 25% total. Calculate the combined amount once, round down once, and emit one direct-heal event per target.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Triage

nodes.contract: Field Treatment additionally applies Aftercare for 2 target turns: each turn-end restores floor(cast-time target maximum HP / 20), minimum 1, capped at missing HP. Aftercare and Regen share one recovery-over-time slot. Existing Regen has priority and retains its potency and remaining duration; this cast neither extends it nor queues Aftercare. Recasting Aftercare refreshes its own duration to 2 without stacking ticks; a later Regen replaces it. No resurrection, Focus multiplier or post-battle ticking.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Aftercare

nodes.contract: Permanent +1 Focus, using the shared potency/accuracy/critical/resistance formulas exactly once.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Clear Focus

nodes.contract: Prism Lance deals 20% more stability damage. Its HP damage, element and cooldown are unchanged.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Prism Lens

nodes.contract: Prism Lance applies Weak for 1 target turn only if the target did not have Weak before the action and is not immune. An existing Weak is neither extended nor replaced by this talent.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Safe Exposure

nodes.contract: Weak newly applied by Orion lasts 1 additional target turn, capped at 3. Does not change potency, extend existing effects retroactively, affect Frozen/Stun/Stagger or bypass immunity.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Steady Field

nodes.contract: Headshot deals 10% more HP damage against a target at or above 75% HP when the hit is evaluated.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Scope

nodes.contract: Headshot gains 5 percentage points of critical chance, subject to the normal critical cap. No other action gains this bonus.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Steady Aim

nodes.contract: Gh0st single-target direct damaging skills deal 15% more HP damage to targets at or below 30% HP before the hit. No instant kill, boss exemption or damage-over-time bonus.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Execute

nodes.contract: Landing a basic attack gives Gh0st one steady-shot charge. His next valid Headshot consumes it for +15% direct HP damage, even if that Headshot misses. Charges do not stack and expire at battle end; invalid or canceled actions consume none. Headshot keeps base cooldown 2, with no talent cooldown refund, ATB grant or critical-hit recharge. The shared +25% talent-damage cap includes Scope and Execute.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Cool Head

nodes.contract: Permanent +1 Agility; Speed/evasion use their shared formulas. No immediate ATB grant.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Quick Position

nodes.contract: Gh0st basic attack deals 20% more stability damage, with no HP damage or extra status bonus.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Surgical Strike

nodes.contract: New active: one enemy; physical; base power 60; agility scaling; cooldown 3 personal turns; applies Weak for 2 target turns, respecting immunity. No Stun, silence or instant kill.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Disarm

nodes.contract: Once per battle, prevent a scheduled-turn skip caused by Stun or Stagger on Gh0st, removing those two effects from him. Frozen and other unhandled skip effects remain; if any would still skip this turn, do not activate or consume Recenter. Other statuses remain; no bonus action, counterattack, damage or team-wide immunity.
nodes.status: implemented in opt-in prototype; focused runtime and integration coverage; human balance pending
nodes.name: Recenter

screening_limits: Starter/level/explicit event and dialogue unlocks only. Missing sources are not proof of unreachable content. Every active/passive requires executable effect and real-route verification.

proposed_core_adjustments.reason: Keep basic recovery available independently of the optional Field Medic tree.
proposed_core_adjustments.grant: Orion recruitment; exact production callback to be verified
proposed_core_adjustments.scaling_rule: Direct heal: round(18 * (1 + effective Focus * .01)); no damage. Shield is 25% incoming reduction under reviewed shared stacking rules.
proposed_core_adjustments.story_contract: Orion treats wounds and damaged protective gear with available medical equipment. No Aethel technology-origin claim, copied identity, resurrection or Anchor time manipulation. Existing Nano Repair remains separately reviewed.

proposed_core_adjustments.reason: Separate element from applied statuses; current element-tag inference can apply Frozen beyond the described Brittle effect.

migration_policy: Proposed one-time legacy respec compensation equal to old catalog costs of recorded old-tree unlocks, deliberately including ambiguous free grants; not an exact paid-AP refund. Preserve owned combat skills; remove replaced old passive flags; version compensation permanently across NG+. Backfill only proven new quest/recruitment grants, not existing boss rewards.
design_scope: 32 AP nodes: 5 new actives and 27 passive/augment/conditional purchases. Field Patch uses the existing orion_stasis_stitch ID and is a proposed core grant, not an AP purchase.

story_contracts.gh0st_recenter_v2: A recovery routine Gh0st develops and chooses to practice after the Foundry. Automatic trigger represents a practiced response, not a Dominion command, Elara memory, Nova ownership or Source Lock. It does not break Frozen/time stasis.
story_contracts.orion_field_care: Field Patch, Field Treatment and Aftercare use grounded medical/repair language and recipient-appropriate care. No new consumable costs or universal nanite/Source explanation. The medical equipment origin is not asserted to be Aethel.

focused_validation_cases.expected: Only an on-cooldown Cover cast committed below 30% target HP spends the one battle charge; ordinary ready casts do not. Reset cooldown to 3 and spend a normal ATB action.
No additional Guard or stronger Shield is produced. Refresh one ordinary Shield; invalid/dead/canceled targets spend no emergency charge.
At unchanged maximum HP 120, Field Treatment restores 24 HP, or 30 below 35% HP. Aftercare adds at most two 6-HP ticks if enough HP is missing. Emergency total is 42 HP, not 56, and cooldown is 4.
Regen at one remaining turn is not extended, multiplied or followed by queued Aftercare. Identical Aftercare refreshes duration without adding a tick source; battle end clears it.
A basic hit arms one charge; repeated basics do not stack. A committed Headshot consumes it even on a miss. Base cooldown stays 2; Headshot/crit/weakness reward never arms a new charge.
Scope 10% plus charged Headshot 15% gives 25%; Execute 15% plus charged Headshot 15% is capped at 25%, including allied talent bonuses.
Stun/Stagger-only skip consumes the one charge and removes those effects. Mixed Frozen plus Stun still skips and spends no charge; the routine supplies no extra action or immunity to actual stasis.
Emergency charge, steady-shot charge and Recenter use survive battle checkpoint reload; save/load does not restore spent charges or duplicate recovery ticks.

story.gh0st: Recenter is self-developed and excludes actual stasis.
story.orion: Field Patch, Field Treatment and Aftercare use practical field-care presentation, without an asserted Aethel nanotechnology origin.

balance.last_line: One ordinary on-cooldown Cover cast, normal action cost, normal mitigation, full cooldown reset.
balance.field_treatment: 20% direct, 25% in emergency, cooldown 4; Aftercare two 5% ticks, no Regen stacking/extension.
balance.cool_head: Base cooldown 2 remains; one basic-hit preparation charge for +15% Headshot damage subject to the shared cap.
